shellCommands.command: git ls-files && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v .git/ | head -100 && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/

for f in pages/*.js pages/*/*.js pages/api/posts/*.js components/*.js styles/globals.css next.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; ls __agent_eval__; git diff package.json
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs; find 01-app -type f | head -300; cat ../../package.json | grep '"version"'
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; cat 02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions; cat 02-route-segment-config/index.md 02-route-segment-config/dynamicParams.md; grep -n "revalidate\|cacheComponents" -r ../05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md | head -30

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; F=/home/vercel-sandbox/.claude/projects/-workspace/bae08a88-9ae1-4aa0-a52e-87151ce26a99/tool-results/btk2n18zg.txt; grep -n "^#" $F; sed -n '/## Migrating from `pages` to `app`/,$p' $F | grep -v '^```\(bash\|js\)' | head -700 | cut -c1-300

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; F=/home/vercel-sandbox/.claude/projects/-workspace/bae08a88-9ae1-4aa0-a52e-87151ce26a99/tool-results/btk2n18zg.txt; sed -n '860,935p' $F; grep -n "PageProps\|LayoutProps\|RouteContext" -r . | cut -c1-250 | head -40

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; sed -n '/^## Route Segment Config/,/^## [A-Z]/p' ../02-guides/caching-without-cache-components.md | head -80; grep -n "fetch\b.*default\|auto no cache\|Default" 04-functions/fetch.md | head; sed -n '1,80p' 03-file-conventions/error.md
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; sed -n '80,400p' 03-file-conventions/error.md | grep -v '^$'

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; grep -n "^#" 02-guides/caching-without-cache-components.md; grep -n -A25 "^### \`revalidate\`\|route-segment-config-revalidate\|^#### \`revalidate\`" 02-guides/caching-without-cache-components.md | head -80
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; sed -n '147,195p;366,460p' 02-guides/caching-without-cache-components.md
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; grep -v '^$' 02-guides/incremental-static-regeneration.md | sed -n '1,120p'

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; grep -v '^$' 03-file-conventions/route.md | sed -n '1,140p' | grep -v '^```js' ; grep -n -B3 -A30 "Page Props Helper\|## Page props\|PageProps" 03-file-conventions/page.md | head -60
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; grep -v '^$' 03-file-conventions/not-found.md | grep -v '^```jsx' | sed -n '1,120p'

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; sed -n '/## Reference/,$p' 03-file-conventions/not-found.md | grep -n -i "metadata" ; grep -n -i "memoiz\|dedup\|React.cache\|cache(" 04-functions/generate-metadata.md ../01-getting-started/14-metadata-and-og-images.md | head; ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/

cd /workspace; curl -s -m 10 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1; curl -s -m 10 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter"; grep -rn "405" node_modules/next/dist/server/route-modules/app-route/module.js | head -5; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs 2>/dev/null | head -5

cd /workspace; grep -rln "status: 405" node_modules/next/dist/server/ | head; grep -rn -B2 -A8 "function handleMethodNotAllowedResponse\|handleMethodNotAllowed" node_modules/next/dist/server/route-modules/helpers/response-handlers.js 2>/dev/null | head -20
cd /workspace; cat node_modules/next/dist/server/route-modules/app-route/helpers/auto-implement-methods.js | head -80
cd /workspace; mkdir -p app/blog/\[id\] app/api/posts/\[id\] types && git rm -q components/AppProvider.js && ls

cd /workspace; sed -i "s/HomePage(_props: PageProps<'\/'>)/HomePage()/" app/page.tsx; sed -i "s/BlogIndex(_props: PageProps<'\/blog'>)/BlogIndex()/" app/blog/page.tsx; grep -n "export default" app/page.tsx app/blog/page.tsx
cd /workspace; sed -i 's/^export interface ApiPost/interface ApiPost/' app/api/posts/route.ts; git rm -rq pages && rm -rf pages && ls; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

cd /workspace; (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 5
for p in / /blog /blog/1 /blog/50 /blog/9999 /nope /api/posts /api/posts/7; do echo "$p -> $(curl -s -o /tmp/out.html -w '%{http_code}' localhost:3123$p) $(grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/out.html | head -1)"; done
curl -s -X POST localhost:3123/api/posts -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"a","content":"b"}' -w ' %{http_code}\n'
curl -s -X POST localhost:3123/api/posts -d 'bad' -w ' %{http_code}\n'
curl -s -X PUT localhost:3123/api/posts/3 -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"x"}' -w ' %{http_code}\n'
curl -s -X DELETE localhost:3123/api/posts/3 -w ' %{http_code}\n'
curl -s -X PATCH localhost:3123/api/posts/3 -w ' %{http_code}\n'
curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'Your user agent: [^<]*\|og:title[^>]*'
pkill -f "next start"; cat /tmp/next.log | tail -5

cd /workspace; npx next build 2>&1 | grep -i "error\|warn\|✓ Compiled\|Finished TypeScript"; (npx next start -p 3124 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s localhost:3124/ | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>'; pkill -f "next start"; npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC OK; git status --short
cd /workspace; npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC OK; git status --short; git diff tsconfig.json; cat next-env.d.ts

cd /workspace; printf '.next/
next-env.d.ts
*.tsbuildinfo
' >> .gitignore; git status --short | grep '??'; find app components types -type f | sort
